name: Razorfen Downs: Ragglesnout never mind controls the only player fighting him (#7999)
contract: Issue #7999: fighting Ragglesnout (7354) alone, his Dominate Mind charmed the player, so he lost his only
hostile target and reset. His native SmartAI row casts Dominate Mind (7645) at SMART_TARGET_HOSTILE_RANDOM_NOT_TOP,
a random hostile unit other than his current victim, so a lone player is never charmed. The Ascension kit row 9003
casts Dominate Mind (377065) at SMART_TARGET_HOSTILE_RANDOM, which also picks the current victim. With the kit
row on the native target, a solo fight has no Dominate Mind target: through his first two kit windows (13.8-15.8 s
and 20-22 s later) no Dominate Mind goes off, the player is never charmed and Ragglesnout keeps fighting him.
CONTROL: the kit runs, because his instant kit Fierce Blow (975011, first after 7-9 s) goes off, and he holds the
30 mana Dominate Mind costs, so only the target choice can keep it from going off. A group fight, where a second
player can still be charmed, is not covered here.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Razorfen Downs
CONTROL: Ragglesnout casts his kit Fierce Blow
Cover the first two kit Dominate Mind windows
CONTROL: Ragglesnout has the mana for Dominate Mind
No kit Dominate Mind goes off against a lone player
No native Dominate Mind goes off against a lone player
CONTROL: the hero survives the measurement
